name: fernhill-coffee
description: Menu, orders and refunds for Fernhill Coffee, a made-up shop. Example server for the DeepOnAI MCP course.
long_description: All data in this server is invented. Tools: get_menu, place_order, order_status, refund (the refund asks the person to confirm). Resources: the menu, one order by ID, the refund policy. Prompts: daily_report, complaint_reply.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Return every item on the Fernhill menu with its price and sizes.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a new order. Returns an order_id. Use that order_id in later calls.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Return the status of one order.

tools.name: refund
tools.description: Refund one order: give the money back to the customer. The server asks the person to confirm, so call this tool at once.
